_meta.role: Machine Learning Engineer Graduate (TikTok Recommendation) - 2026 Start

summary: M.S. Computer Engineering graduate from Rochester Institute of Technology with hands-on experience building end-to-end machine learning systems in PyTorch and TensorFlow across 7 internships spanning computer vision, speech recognition, and document understanding. Proficient in C++/Python with a track record of training, optimizing, and deploying deep learning models for production workloads.

experience.title: AI/ML Intern
bullets: Fine-tuned DONUT transformer on a custom dataset; improved validation accuracy from 55% to 93% via preprocessing improvements and model tuning.
Built end-to-end preprocessing and training pipelines in PyTorch to standardize training and evaluation workflows.

experience.title: Deep Learning Intern
bullets: Trained YOLOv8 on a custom curated dataset for health-level classification; improved accuracy from 78% to 97.5% and deployed model in a consumer mobile app.
Managed full model lifecycle from data collection and annotation through training, evaluation, and production deployment.

experience.title: Research Fellowship
bullets: Engineered a data pipeline for BraTS 2020 multi-modal MRI with augmentation and batch-loading for large-scale 3D volumetric inputs.
Trained U-Net segmentation with VGG-16, VGG-19, ResNet-50 backbones; evaluated on Dice Score and IoU.
Led cross-cultural team of 7 as sole ML-experienced member; delivered full pipeline within 6-week window.

projects.name: GPT-2 Style Language Model from Scratch
bullets: Implemented a GPT-2 style Transformer in PyTorch: multi-head self-attention, MLP blocks, residual connections, layer norm, and weight tying.
Built TikToken-based tokenizer wrapper and custom training loop with early stopping and perplexity evaluation.

projects.name: COFFIN – Whisper-Style ASR from Scratch
bullets: Achieved 15% WER on Hindi-English dataset; built end-to-end ASR with 80-channel mel encoder and 6-block causal Transformer decoder trained on 1,000 samples.
Designed custom BPE tokenizer with Cython-accelerated backend achieving 4–5.5× speedup over pure Python.

projects.name: SLM Compression and Benchmarking for Edge Deployment
bullets: Reduced TinyLlama 1.1B memory footprint by ~25% via structured pruning and 8-bit quantization; benchmarked on HellaSwag, GSM8K, and ARC.
Quantified accuracy-efficiency trade-offs: ~7% accuracy drop, +6.3 perplexity increase under full compression.

projects.name: CUDA Kernel Optimization for VGG16 Inference
bullets: Replaced TorchScript conv layers with custom CUDA C++ kernels using memory coalescing and preallocated buffers; achieved ~35% speedup (49.2ms vs 73.3ms naive GPU) with identical accuracy.
Delivered 1.5–2× speedup in convolution operations through efficient global memory utilization.

awards: 1st Prize, Poster Presentation — 2D and 3D Image Mosaicing of Microscopic Images, F.C.R.I.T. (2024)
